blocks.text: Critical thinking skills (soch samajh kar parakhne ki maharat) maloomat ka analysis (hisson mein baant kar ghaur se dekhna) aur parakh ke liye zaroori hain. Is ka matlab hai maloomat par sawal uthana, alag alag perspectives (soch ke zaviye, yaani doosre log is baat ko kaise dekhte hain) ko dekhna, aur poori maloomat le kar (informed) faisla karna.
Misal: Agar aap kisi nayi technology ke bare mein parhein, to critical thinking ka matlab hai ke raaye banane se pehle alag alag sources aur perspectives dekhein.

blocks.prompt: Critical thinking maloomat ke zimmedari wale istemal mein kaise madad deti hai? Asal zindagi ki misalein dein. (Long question 3)
blocks.explanation: Critical thinking hamein kisi baat ko maanne ya share karne se pehle sawal karna sikhati hai: kaun keh raha hai, saboot kya hai, aur doosre sources kya kehte hain. Is se ghalat maloomat aage nahi phailti aur faisle behtar hote hain. Misalein (hamari, kitab ki nahi): 1) Koi viral message kahe ke gharelu nuskha (ghar ka desi ilaj) bimari theek karta hai, to forward karne se pehle doctor ya sehat ke official idare se check karein. 2) Nayi technology ya phone khareedne se pehle sirf company ka ishtihar nahi, alag alag reviews aur sources dekhein (kitab ki misal bhi yahi kehti hai). 3) Sensational (sansani phailane wali) headline dekh kar poori khabar parhein aur doosre news organizations se milayein.

items: Critical thinking: sawal karein, alag alag perspectives dekhein, soch samajh kar faisla karein.
